description: 实时追踪企业全生命周期动态，覆盖投资设立、股权变动、创新平台、中标、知识产权、排名、迁移、资质认定、工商变更、上市、标准制定、招聘、拿地等维度，并提供企业实体匹配。

display.description_en: Tracks company dynamics across its full lifecycle: investment, equity changes, innovation platforms, bidding, IP, rankings, migration, certifications, business changes, IPO, standards, recruitment, land acquisition, with entity matching.
display.description_zh: 实时追踪企业全生命周期动态，覆盖投资设立、股权变动、创新平台、中标、知识产权、排名、迁移、资质认定、工商变更、上市、标准制定、招聘、拿地等维度，并提供企业实体匹配。
examples_en: Track BYD's investment, establishment and equity-change events over the past year
Query a company's IP and bidding dynamics in the AI field
Compare two companies' recruitment and land-acquisition trends in the last six months
Match a company name to its entity ID, then review its IPO and business-change records
examples_zh: 追踪比亚迪近一年的投资设立与股权变动动态
查询某企业在人工智能领域的知识产权与中标动态
对比两家公司近半年的招聘与拿地动态趋势
通过企业名称匹配其实体 ID 后查看其上市与工商变更记录
